contract.poseSource: Frozen Animator speed0; normalized phase from live AI, measured travel and warning/arrival/death clocks. Bone TRS is cached and republished in LateUpdate after Mecanim; .08second Idle/Walk blend.
contract.initialEditorAssetPreparation: Missing assets and recognized generated8/10-state assets prepared natively after import. Generated upgrade backs up controller/prefab/definition plus .meta, keeps original state objects and GUIDs. Different/custom visual graphs are preserved and warned.
contract.authoredFeedback: Captured/restored original renderer property block, retained alpha/unrelated overrides; no capsule squash on model
contract.arrivalCompatibility: Typed Ground/Hatch selects new states if present, otherwise legacy Emerge stretched to chosen duration.
contract.sourceGeometry: 12 separately editable closed parts; face and helmet rigid Head; capped ribbed mechanical neck; one temporary joined game skin.
contract.breakupGeometry: Six static centered-pivot chunks sharing original atlas; no runtime BakeMesh.
contract.deathPresentation: Immediate bounded gear burst and occasional six-part breakup; original chunk scale is immutable across Heavy/Runner pool reuse.
contract.archetypePresentation: Shared V19 source rig/atlas, persistent multiplicative tint and rigid uniform scale .90/1/1.12; gameplay capsule and distance-based walk cadence follow scale.
contract.danger: Committed last .14seconds of the authored default windup; final live target position/range/cone/occlusion are checked at the strike boundary. Accepted hits show Hurt without cancelling a committed attack.
contract.crowd: Eight target-specific reserved approach lanes, stable far-side orbit, all-target personal-space steering and final-step swept-circle clipping.

limitations: No native Unity Editor import/type compilation, Play Mode, Animator, PhysX, Profiler capture or mobile device execution was performed here.
Existing mechanical source geometry and Blender/FBX evidence were produced for V19 and are unchanged in V20. The V20 runtime scale/tint and skin presentation still require native viewing.
